callLines.line: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.

anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Maya Diallo. From Stonebridge." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 1 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Rafael Murphy. From Thornfield." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold REFUSES. debts unpaid between you. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)
— Stonebridge REFUSES. debts unpaid between you. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)
— Thornfield answers! Talia Hassan and Lucia Ali will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)

🛡️ Marcus steps forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Marcus marches with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 3 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
